findings.title: Depends on Harrington Health: MSA + BAA, which is not signed (latest verdict HOLD)
findings.impact: Sending this commits AtliQ to a vendor/contractor before the client contract it serves is resolved. HOLD: Multiple missing agreements, client consents, and unconfirmed offshore patient data disclosure.

findings.title: Lack of Client Consent Requirement for Subcontracting
findings.impact: AtliQ could engage or permit subcontractors without client approval, conflict MSA Article 2.5 and BAA Article 4.2.

citations.quote: The Contractor may not assign or subcontract this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent
Contractor shall not subcontract any portion of the Services without Client's prior written consent. Contractor shall remain fully responsible for any subcontractor's performance

findings.standard: Apply the same standard AtliQ asks for as a supplier: capped penalties or none, 30-day pay, mutual caps, no pay-when-paid, fair termination. Pass the client's obligations down (IP, confidentiality, data protection, consent), never the client's leverage.
findings.counterPosition: Update the clause to state that any subcontracting requires prior written consent from both AtliQ and the end Client (Harrington).

fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Inc for a USA end client

Correct AtliQ entity: Inc for a USA counterparty

IP assignment effectively secures work product ownership for client pass-through.
Payment terms of 30 days match AtliQ standard.
Start date properly conditioned on the Effective Date, avoiding premature commencement.
Confidentiality obligations and survival match playbook standard.
Termination for convenience and cause align with standard terms.
NDA definition: The definition covers non-public information disclosed by either party, explicitly including business plans, technical details, and Mr. Ortiz's rates.
NDA obligations: Both parties are bound as Receiving Parties to protect the other's information with reasonable care and use it solely for the Purpose.
NDA residuals: The agreement does not contain a residuals clause, which is acceptable and neutral.
notSeen: Register built from 17 signed documents. Contracts referenced elsewhere but never collected (e.g. ShopSwift SOW, PixelCraft vendor agreement, intercompany services agreement) can't be checked.
